rationale: With only 17 minutes to close and forced liquidation at market, the risk/reward is unfavorable: the stock has already fallen ~4.5% from prior close and sits near the low of its range (12.6% position), but the ATR is small ($0.097 on 5m bars) relative to the spread and slippage risk at end-of-day. The last few candles show low-volume, choppy price action with no clear directional momentum, and the broad market is under pressure (SPY -1.21%, VIXY +8.96%), making a sustained bounce unlikely in this window. With today's realized P&L already -$204 and limited time to manage a position, the asymmetric downside of a forced market-close liquidation outweighs any potential edge.
